decisions.outcome: If done_callback_ is null it returns with no state change. If non-null, the callback is invoked (line 266) before the state reset at lines 267-270, which sets is_currently_running_ to false, clears active_submit_button_ and invocation_id_, and is followed by PseudoStateChanged notifications (lines 271-274). At the callback, the reset has not run, so those fields hold pre-completion values unless the callback changes them; the excerpt does not show what the callback does.

decisions.outcome: The settlement is ignored: the function returns without calling the done callback.

decisions.condition: PrepareForSubmission reaches the should_submit branch and executing_tool remains CurrentlyRunning after ScheduleFormSubmission returns.
decisions.outcome: CallDoneCallback runs with base::ok of a null String, which the source comment describes as a navigation-intent sentinel: internal, and not proof of navigation, success, or any CDP output value. The ok call follows the ScheduleFormSubmission call in the same block and is guarded only by executing_tool remaining CurrentlyRunning; it is not conditioned on navigation being scheduled. The body of ScheduleFormSubmission is outside the retained anchor.
